questions.question: B175 browser proof: the two cases that show B175's effect cannot be reached in a browser because of bugs that also exist on dev today. (1) A report with a missing image never opens the editor (B500), so the attach button can't be reached. (2) A package with more than 50 image files is refused (B501). The B175 behaviour is proven by pipeline tests and real-database tests, and a reviewer approved it. How do you want B175 shipped?

options.label: Ship, label proof (Recommended)
options.description: Push both PRs once (pipeline first). The PRs say 'B175 effect not proven in browser' and name the blocking bugs B500 and B501. I run one browser check that a normal PDF import still exports when host load drops (it is about 450 now). The browser proof of B175 becomes part of B500's acceptance.

options.label: Hold until B500
options.description: Keep both commits local. Fix B500 first in a new tab, then prove B175 end to end in a browser, then push. B175 waits until then.

questions.question: Should we ship the image provenance change today, or should we wait until the editor bug is fixed and proven in a real browser?
